info.title: Neon Self-hosted Control API
info.description: Implemented self-hosted control API. M2 creation is enabled only when capability discovery reports its driver ready; unsupported SaaS Backend services remain disabled.

runtime.description: Observed workload state. Managed VM observations include workload_uid and workload_created_at for generation-scoped idle evidence; absent/unknown observations cannot qualify for automatic suspension.

endpoint_type.description: Read-only computes share branch storage and can be created multiple times.

parent_timestamp.description: RFC3339 historical time, mutually exclusive with parent_lsn. Requires pitr_new_branch; only retained, replayed history is accepted.

parent_lsn.description: Retained WAL point, mutually exclusive with parent_timestamp. A distinct branch is created; existing Endpoints are unchanged.

password.description: Required only for read_write; forbidden for read_only.

CreateEndpoint.description: type defaults to read_write. A writer requires a new password; a read_only endpoint must omit password and reuses the branch writer role verifier.

password.description: Only for new local accounts (12-256 characters). Existing accounts must omit or send empty password; this does not reset a shared account.

project_id.description: Only on organization endpoint; must belong to that organization. Empty means organization scope.

token.description: Only returned once. ncp_ prefix, cryptographically random. Server stores only SHA256 digest.

jwks.description: Static public RS256/EdDSA keys only; private parameters rejected

expires_at.description: Required expiry, between one minute and 30 days; enforced by the verifier

api_token.description: Returned once on the first create/rotate response, never in durable replay or list. Lost response requires rotation.

items.description: Exact trusted browser origin; no wildcard, credentials, path, query or fragment.

patch.description: Queues an idempotent autoscaling soft-bounds update. Reconciliation validates endpoint ownership and immutable NeonVM capacity, persists the Proxy cold-wake template with Secret resourceVersion compare-and-swap, then patches the live VM with UID/resourceVersion checks and verifies the resume template before committing endpoint metadata. Suspended endpoints update their resume template without waking compute. A live VM whose current allocation exceeds the requested maximum rejects the operation; the requested bounds must fit its immutable hard min/max. Partial external failure marks the Operation failed/retryable rather than committing success, and retry converges the same desired bounds. Connection fencing and cross-instance lifecycle races remain an independent production gate.

post.summary: Execute SQL through Neon Proxy

role.description: Optional public role. Defaults to endpoint role; protected internal identities rejected.

database.description: Optional database. Defaults to endpoint database.

422.description: Invalid input, database authentication or PostgreSQL query error; retryable=false.

502.description: Database TLS certificate verification failed; retryable=false.

503.description: Database connection unavailable. retryable=true only before user SQL was sent.

504.description: Connection or query budget exceeded. retryable=true only before user SQL was sent; otherwise verify the outcome before retrying.

403.description: CSRF validation or global write-role validation failed.

post.description: Executes SQL through Neon Proxy with a 180-second total budget. The connection and cold-wake budget defaults to 120 seconds and is configured server-side with NEON_SQL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (5-150 seconds). Query statement_timeout is 120 seconds, additionally bounded by the remaining total budget. Error responses include a request_id correlated to redacted structured logs. A timeout or connection loss after SQL was sent can have an unknown outcome: retryable=false, so clients must verify the outcome before retrying writes. SQL is never automatically retried by this gateway. During connection setup the fixed Proxy can encode password authentication failures and cold-wake internal failures as XX000. The gateway recognizes the documented password authentication prefix only during connect and returns 422 with retryable=false; other internal connection failures return 503 before user SQL is submitted. Raw PostgreSQL messages are never exposed or logged.

post.summary: Accept invitation as its authenticated existing account
Create a local Console account with a valid invitation
post.description: Same-origin POST; new accounts only. Username must match invitation. Existing accounts must sign in to accept, no password reset. Registration and membership and token consumption and audit commit atomically. Login remains a separate step. Invalid/expired/revoked/consumed invitation or demoted inviter returns 422. Shared PG admission cap: 20 per minute per hashed transport peer, including successful requests.
